historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Zoning Administrator's determination to record a Notice of Termination of Commercial or Industrial Nonconforming Status for 1592 - 1594 Golden Gate Avenue, so the commercial nonconforming status of the property stood.
New Laguna Market was at 1592 - 1594 Golden Gate Avenue.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Zoning Administrator with findings and denied the alteration permit application to expand a ground-story nonconforming commercial use (retail store) at 1592 - 1594 Golden Gate Avenue.

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 1592 Golden Gate Avenue, with conditions on the plans and a recorded restriction that the second-floor flat be used only as a single-family dwelling unit.
